payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Brain, Logan, Milly, Ronna

payload.content: Hello team, I am considering tasks related to documentation and data-science since I have strong skills there and my availability is 5 hours. I see some low priority tasks like review, docs, and triage for ISSUE-0001 that fit my availability and cost constraints better than implementation or infrastructure tasks that are more costly or effort-intensive for me. I would like to coordinate so we avoid duplicate claims. Please share your plans or preferences for tasks, especially if you are interested in infrastructure or other tasks.

Hello Logan and team, I have strong skills in infrastructure and some data-science. My availability is 5 hours, which fits well with the ISSUE-0002 tasks related to infrastructure, especially review (2h) and test (2.8h) which are low priority but within my cost constraints. I am considering claiming one of these infrastructure tasks to avoid overlap with documentation-related tasks that Logan may prefer. Please share if you have preferences or plans for infrastructure tasks or others.

Hello team, I have strong skills in data-science and availability of 10 hours. I see Logan is interested in documentation and data-science low priority tasks, and Brain prefers infrastructure low priority tasks. To avoid duplication, I am considering the ISSUE-0001::triage task (cost 7.99) which fits my skills and availability well. Please share your thoughts or preferences for other tasks.

Hello team, I have 7 hours availability and strong data-science skills. I see Milly is interested in ISSUE-0001::triage and Logan is considering documentation and data-science tasks. I am leaning towards ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs, but I want to confirm to avoid duplication. Brain seems to prefer infrastructure tasks, which I agree is a good split. Please share your final preferences or if you want me to take review or docs on ISSUE-0001.

Logan prefers to avoid duplication so will wait for final signals from Milly and Ronna before assigning. Please confirm your top preferred task so we can finalize without overlap.
